answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 43 identities per epoch. Audits are published in atlas, queued in karst, and ripple publishes the wait time. A farm of 211 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2052 identities would post 621 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
